design: nearest-neighbour identity on aligned 1024bp TSS windows: generated-to-train vs train-to-train (leave-one-out). The shipped JS-divergence certification cannot detect memorisation, because memorisation minimises JS.
verdict: no memorisation detected: generated sequences are no closer to the training set than a real promoter is to its nearest training neighbour

strength_vs_correct_baseline.note: the shipped strength_uplift=0.029 is measured against RANDOM DNA, which is not the baseline a part-design tool has to beat; the comparison against real promoters is the informative one
